versions.changelog:
- Initial release of token-cost-optimizer skill.
- Provides systematic guidance to reduce OpenClaw token usage and API costs across eight optimization dimensions.
- Includes step-by-step diagnostic, analysis, optimization, and monitoring procedures.
- Offers quick diagnostic scripts and suggested configurations for context control, model selection, agent workflow, and scheduled tasks.
- Supplies reference checklists and model pricing comparisons for ongoing cost management.
